about: Opens a panel over a dimmed page and keeps focus in it until the reader closes it. Escape, a press on the backdrop, the close button and an action button close it, and focus returns to the trigger.

alert.about: An alert dialog before a destructive action. It takes `role="alertdialog"` and focuses Cancel, its first button, when it opens. A press on the backdrop leaves it open. The status line below the trigger announces the result.
alert.title: Alert

commands.about: The command palette in a `plain` dialog, which renders no panel of its own around the palette. The trigger, ⌘K and Ctrl+K open it, and running a command closes it.
commands.title: Command palette

confirm.description: Services that use this key stop working at once. You cannot undo it.
confirm.title: Revoke the production key?

form.about: A form in the body with its submit button in the footer, joined by the button's `form` attribute. Send checks the address and keeps the dialog open with the error until the address is valid.
form.title: Form

invite.check: Enter an email address such as name@example.com.
invite.description: They get an email with a link to join the workspace.
invite.title: Invite a teammate

nested.about: A dialog opened from another. The second backdrop dims the first dialog, Escape closes the top dialog alone, and Delete project closes both.
nested.title: Nested

placement.about: The panel at the top of the window, in the middle and at the bottom. A panel taller than the window starts at the top under every placement.
placement.title: Placements

scrollBehavior.about: Terms longer than the window. Inside, the body scrolls and the header and the footer remain in view. Outside, the window scrolls the whole panel.
scrollBehavior.title: Scrolling

settings.danger: Deleting the project removes its 12 dashboards for everyone in the workspace.

deletion.description: This removes the project and its dashboards. You cannot undo it.
deletion.title: Delete the Atlas project?

settings.title: Project settings

shared.about: One dialog opened by three triggers. Each trigger passes its `value`, the root reports the pressed one as `triggerValue`, and focus returns to that trigger.
shared.title: Shared

shortcuts.description: Press these anywhere in the workspace.
shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts

size.about: The five widths from 24 to 56rem, then `cover`, which fills the window inside a margin, and `full`, which fills the window. A panel is never wider than the window less its margin.
size.title: Sizes

accounts.body: You are responsible for the activity on your account and for keeping its password secret. Tell us at once if you suspect someone else has used it.
accounts.title: Your account

billing.body: Paid plans renew each month or each year until you cancel. We charge the card on file at the start of each period and send a receipt to the billing address.
billing.title: Billing

changes.body: We tell you by email at least 30 days before a change takes effect. If you keep using the service after that date, the new terms apply.
changes.title: Changes to these terms

contact.body: Send questions about these terms to legal@example.com. We reply within five working days.
contact.title: Contact

content.body: You keep every right to what you upload. You give us permission to store, copy and display it only to run the service for you.
content.title: Your content

liability.body: The service is provided as it is. Our total liability for any claim is limited to the amount you paid us in the 12 months before the claim.
liability.title: Liability

privacy.body: We collect what we need to run the service and nothing else. The privacy notice lists every kind of data we keep and how long we keep it.
privacy.title: Privacy

termination.body: You can close your account at any time from the settings page. We delete your content 30 days after you close it.
termination.title: Closing your account

title: Dialog
